news.title: ELO System Overhaul Live
news.content: The ELO system has been updated with EMA-based K-factor tuning and improved dynamic K scaling. Rankings are now more accurately reflecting true skill levels. Check the leaderboard to see the latest standings.

news.title: Tournament 3 Results
news.content: Tournament 3 has concluded! Check out the final standings and see how the results impacted ELO ratings across the board.

news.title: Season 2 Format Launched
news.content: Season 2 introduces a brand new match format with best-of-5 rounds, new arenas, and enhanced tracking. Read the full announcement for details on what has changed.

news.title: New Analytics Tools Available
news.content: Explore the revamped analytics dashboard featuring archetype diversity charts, upset analysis, part synergy heatmaps, and the power rankings overview.

news.title: Record-Breaking Match Result
news.content: An incredible upset was recorded in the latest session — a C-Tier Bey took down the current #1 ranked Bey in a stunning 3-0 victory. Check the upset analysis for full details.
